blocks.x: What Healthcare & Life Sciences means at Dataq Software: the scope we sign, the architecture we ship, the evidence generated in-flight, and the per 1,000 patients outcomes measured against your audited baseline.

Healthcare generates the most consequential data in the economy and spends most of it unread. Radiology backlogs, prior-authorization ping-pong, coding leakage, clinical trial recruitment shortfalls — each is an information problem wearing an operational costume. The organizations improving outcomes are the ones treating data interoperability (FHIR, TEFCA-style exchange) and clinical-grade AI governance as infrastructure, not innovation theater.

blocks.x: The regulatory bar is the highest in any industry: HIPAA and GDPR privacy regimes, FDA oversight where software informs clinical decisions, EU AI Act classification for medical AI, and GxP validation for pharma-adjacent systems. That bar is passable — but only when controls, documentation and validation are designed into delivery from the first sprint, which is precisely how Dataq Software builds.
